newsDocuments.headline: Brent oil price benchmark set for biggest weekly drop since 2020

segments.text: HOUSTON: Oil prices were set for a sharp weekly fall after the election losses of US President Donald Trump’s Republican Party raised hopes of a de-escalation in the US-Israeli war on Iran, though attacks on vessels in the Middle East conti

In a see-saw session on Friday, Brent crude futures for January were down 45 cents, or 0.46 percent, at USD97.84 a barrel by 10:34 a.m. CDT (1637 GMT). US West Texas Intermediate futures edged up 15 cents, or 0.17 percent to USD90.67.

While the US midterms’ results raised hopes of a potential Iran war de-escalation and more crude exports out of the region, they also raised expectations of tighter US regulations for the AI industry, prompting a dramatic rout in technology

newsDocuments.headline: Govt cuts petrol price by Rs6.59, diesel by Rs4.25 per litre

segments.text: The federal government reduced the price of petrol by Rs6.59 per litre to Rs346 and high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs4.25 per litre to Rs378, effective November 7, 2026.

According to a press release issued by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) on Friday, the regulator revised the ex-depot prices of petroleum products under the federal government’s petroleum pricing mechanism.
Petrol was previously priced at Rs352.59 per litre, while diesel at Rs382.25 per litre.
